architecture.note: There is one learned decision agent. Policy rules constrain serving and explanations summarize decisions; they do not choose player actions.

rules.reason: Cold-start players need safe onboarding before elite difficulty is unlocked.
Avoid repeated resource grants before enough behavior history exists.
Reward saturation is high; resource grants are blocked to control economy inflation.
Temporary power boosts are blocked when recent reward exposure is already high.
Do not increase challenge while the player is frustrated or at elevated churn risk.
Enemy reductions require repeated failure or low win probability.
High fatigue should prioritize recovery over difficulty changes.

rules.condition: advanced_player == true and frustration_score < 0.45 and win_probability > 0.55
rules.reason: Advanced low-frustration players can receive harder content to prevent boredom.

rollback_conditions: avg_cost materially exceeds rule_based without win-rate improvement
final_churn_risk is worse than rule_based in cold_start or new_player_stuck scenarios
